name: Marta Temido, Adam Jarubas - Article 1 – alinéa 1 – point 3; Directive 2001/18/CE – Article 24 septies – paragraphe 1 - Am 131
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2001/18/EC and 2010/53/EU as regards the placing on the market of genetically modified micro-organisms and the processing of organs
part_text: 1. Monitoring of GMMs shall be obligatory throughout the entire period of authorisation, including after renewal, in order to verify the assumptions of the environmental risk assessment, taking into account the ability of microorganisms to evolve rapidly and adapt to different environmental conditions. The authorisation holder shall be responsible for carrying out the monitoring and submitting the results to the European Commission and EFSA, as appropriate.
